name: Show Shipping Class in Product Page for Woocommerce
author: BytePlugs

sections.description:
Let your customers know about the shipping class of each product with this easy-to-use plugin. Perfect for showing estimated delivery times, handling requirements, or shipping methods directly on your product pages.

After activation, the plugin automatically displays the shipping class selected in WooCommerce Shipping settings on your product pages and shop pages.

Key Features

  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)
  • Automatically displays shipping class on product pages and shop pages
  • Dynamically shows different shipping classes for variable products based on the selected variation
  • Includes a shortcode for placing shipping class information anywhere on your site
  • Compatible with Elementor and other page builders
  • Includes WordPress widget for sidebars and widget areas
  • No configuration required – works immediately after activation
  • Lightweight with no impact on page loading speed

Shortcode Usage

Use the shortcode [show_shipping_class] to display the shipping class of a product.

Example:
[show_shipping_class product_id=”123″ label=”Ships via:” class=”my-custom-class” before=”

” after=”

“]

Parameters:
* product_id – ID of the product (optional, defaults to current product)
* label – Text to display before the shipping class (optional)
* class – CSS class for the shipping class element (optional)
* before – HTML to display before the shipping class (optional)
* after – HTML to display after the shipping class (optional)

Elementor Widget

The plugin includes a dedicated Elementor widget that can be found in the “Byteplugs” widget category. Use this widget to display shipping class information anywhere in your Elementor designs.

WordPress Widget

Use the included WordPress widget to display shipping class information in widget areas like sidebars and footers.

Customization

You can customize the appearance of the shipping class using CSS. Example:

css:
.product-shipping-class {
color: #0066cc;
font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: bold;
}

.product-shipping-class-catalogue {
color: #0066cc;
font-size: 14px;
}

.product-shipping-class-shortcode {
color: #0066cc;
font-style: italic;
}

Works with all themes and doesn’t create conflicts

sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or download from WordPress repository
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress
  3. That’s it! The plugin starts working immediately
  4. Optional: Use the shortcode, widget, or Elementor widget for advanced placement
sections.faq:
How can I change the appearance of the shipping class displayed in product page?

Simply go to your theme’s custom CSS field and add the following:
css
.product-shipping-class {
color: #your_color_here;
font-family: your_font_family_here;
font-size: your_font_size_here;
font-weight: your_weight_here;
}

And hit Save.

How do I use the shortcode?

You can use the shortcode [show_shipping_class] on any page or post. If used on a product page, it will automatically display the shipping class of that product. You can also specify a product ID to display the shipping class of a specific product anywhere on your site.

How do I use the Elementor widget?

After activating the plugin, you’ll find a new widget called “Product Shipping Class” in the Elementor editor under the “Byteplugs” category. Simply drag and drop the widget into your design and configure the settings as needed.

What happens when Shipping Class does not appear in product page?

Check if you have created your Shipping Classes or if a Shipping Class is selected for your products in WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping Classes.

Does the plugin support variable products with different shipping classes per variation?

Yes! The plugin now dynamically updates ALL displayed shipping classes when a customer selects a different variation. This includes the main product display, shortcodes, widgets, and Elementor widgets. When a variation is selected, all shipping class displays are synchronized to show the variation’s shipping class.

What settings should I use in order to display the Shipping Class?

No settings needed. Once you activate the plugin it will automatically show the Shipping Class of the product in the product page.

Does the plugin interfere with the functionality of WooCommerce?

No, this plugin is simply an easy way for someone to display the Shipping Class of a product in its product page without affecting WooCommerce functionality.

Is this plugin compatible with page builders other than Elementor?

Yes! The plugin provides a shortcode that can be used with any page builder that supports shortcodes.

How can I support the development of this plugin?

We appreciate your support! You can make a donation via PayPal to help us continue developing and maintaining this plugin. Every contribution helps us create better features and provide timely updates.
